vss.voxy_options.local_chunk_ingestion.t: Convert locally loaded chunks into Voxy LOD. Disable to reduce local conversion work while still receiving server LOD. Existing cached LOD is retained; rendering and prediction are separate settings.
vss.command.render_capture.started: VSS: close chat and keep the affected area in view. One frame will be captured after 3 seconds; this diagnostic may briefly pause rendering.
vss.config.server.title: VSS Local Config
vss.config.server.note: Changes this local client/single-player integrated server only. Dedicated servers should use /vss or the server config file.
vss.config.server.generation_player_conc: Generate at once per server player
vss.config.server.remote_locked: Server settings are locked while connected to a dedicated server. Use /vss on the server instead.
vss.voxy_options.title: Voxy Server Side
vss.voxy_options.performance_tier.toolti: Terrain prediction workers: Low = one quarter of logical processors (up to 4), Medium = one half (up to 8), High = logical processors minus 2. Prediction workers run at lower priority and share concurrency with local terrain generation. Takes effect when entering a world.
vss.voxy_options.receive_server_lods.too: Download Voxy LOD data from the server.
vss.voxy_options.xaero_map_bridge: Write LODs to Xaero's World Map
vss.voxy_options.xaero_map_bridge.toolti: Write received real terrain to Xaero's World Map. Enabled by default. Prediction-to-map conversion is temporarily suspended. Use /vssclient xaero disable to stop real terrain writes, or reload to request existing server cache without generating new LODs.
vss.voxy_options.off_thread_processing.t: Process received LOD chunks on a background thread to reduce main-thread stutter.
vss.voxy_options.prediction.tooltip: Master switch for displaying and generating prediction LODs. This feature is in beta and is enabled by default; turning it off stops generation and withdraws prediction LODs. To pause loading while keeping existing terrain visible, turn off Prediction loading below.
vss.voxy_options.prediction_loading.tool: Generate new areas, refine terrain and load finished meshes from cache. Enabled by default. Turning it off keeps loaded prediction LODs visible; turning it back on resumes loading. Moving into unloaded areas while paused will not fill in prediction terrain. Does not limit real Voxy chunk reception or /vss chunky.
vss.voxy_options.prediction_distance_blo: Set the prediction horizon in blocks, with no excluded outer band. This does not change the VSS server LOD request range.
vss.voxy_options.client_lod_distance.too: Limit the server LOD request radius in chunks. Auto uses the server limit. VSS expands the renderer when its effective range exceeds the Voxy setting.
vss.voxy_options.desired_bandwidth.toolt: Ask the server to cap how much LOD data it sends you. The server cap still wins.
vss.voxy_options.server_sync.tooltip: Main VSS server switch. This only affects the single-player/integrated server; dedicated servers should use /vss or the server config file.
vss.voxy_options.far_player_sync.tooltip: Sync simplified far-away player rendering. This only affects the single-player/integrated server; dedicated servers should use /vss farplayers.
vss.voxy_options.far_player_sync_interva: How many ticks the single-player/integrated server waits between far-player syncs. Lower is fresher but sends more packets.
vss.voxy_options.generation.tooltip: When LOD data is missing, allow the single-player/integrated server to generate chunks and build LOD data. Dedicated servers should change this server-side.
vss.voxy_options.prediction_sync.tooltip: Send the seed and dimension generator metadata used by VSS client prediction.
vss.voxy_options.server_lod_distance.too: How far the single-player/integrated server may sync LODs to players. Dedicated servers should use /vss distance.
vss.voxy_options.server_bandwidth.toolti: Maximum shared server send speed for all players. Each client may still set a personal download limit.
vss.voxy_options.server_queue_count.tool: How many pending LOD chunks may be cached per player. Higher uses more memory; lower can create more gaps.
vss.voxy_options.server_queue_memory.too: How much pending LOD data may be cached per player. Higher uses more memory; lower can create more gaps.
vss.voxy_options.sync_near_rate.tooltip: How many already-generated LOD chunks each player may request per tick within 32 chunks. 0 means unlimited up to one request packet.
vss.voxy_options.sync_mid_rate.tooltip: How many already-generated LOD chunks each player may request per tick from 33 to 64 chunks away.
vss.voxy_options.sync_far_rate.tooltip: How many already-generated LOD chunks each player may request per tick from 65 to 128 chunks away.
vss.voxy_options.sync_distant_rate.toolt: How many already-generated LOD chunks each player may request per tick beyond 128 chunks.
vss.voxy_options.dirty_broadcast_interva: How often the server tells clients to refresh LODs after blocks are placed, broken, or changed by explosions. Lower values refresh faster and send more packets during large edits.
vss.voxy_options.disk_reader_threads.too: How many background threads VSS uses to read existing .vcl LOD files and chunk NBT from disk. Higher can reduce startup catch-up delay on SSDs.
vss.voxy_options.singleplayer_generation: Missing real chunks an integrated server may generate at once per player, including Open to LAN. Default: 2. Prediction, dedicated-server limits and explicit pregeneration are unchanged.
vss.voxy_options.generation_player_concu: Generate at once per server player
Missing real chunks a dedicated server may generate at once per player. Default: 4. Singleplayer uses its own limit. Higher values increase server load.
vss.voxy_options.generation_global_concu: How many missing LOD chunks the whole server may generate at the same time. With C2ME installed, this can usually be raised; other background settings are assigned automatically from hardware performance.

vss.command.help.chunky: /vss chunky — pre-generate real chunks and save authoritative Voxy LOD columns.
vss.command.help.chunky.usage:
Usage: /vss chunky [start] <x> <z> <radius>; /vss chunky here <radius>; /vss chunky rect <x1> <z1> <x2> <z2>; /vss chunky status|pause|resume|cancel.
Queue limit: /vss chunky limit [get]; limit [set] <count>; limit unlimited.
All coordinates and radius are in blocks. The radius is 0-8192 and selects an inclusive square, rounded outward to whole chunks; rectangles accept either corner order, up to 4194304 columns. One active job per server. The queue limit defaults to 0 (unlimited); a positive value bounds unfinished chunk columns, not columns per second. Commands apply immediately and save chunkyQueueLimit without restarting. Lowering the limit lets existing work finish before admitting more.
vss.command.help.chunky.example:
Example: /vss chunky 0 0 512; /vss chunky rect -256 -256 255 255; /vss chunky limit 32; /vss chunky limit unlimited.
Uses the source dimension; /execute in minecraft:the_nether run vss chunky 0 0 128 selects the Nether. Progress is reported every 60 seconds. Jobs survive logout, but stop on server shutdown; saved columns remain subject to the server cache quota. Clients receive them within the normal LOD range. No Chunky mod is required.
